g.text: FROM PAGE TO SCREEN / 05 · POSITIVE & NEGATIVE VOCABULARY

text.style: font-size: 27px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243e3b

g.text: Where do the characters’ words place them?

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: A transparent word-list map: up means more positive-word matches; right means more negative-word matches.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Every matched character appears twice. Arrows connect book circles to film triangles. Colors show story roles.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Hu–Liu opinion lexicon (KDD 2004), exact token matches. Small markers: fewer than 300 words; every profile has ≥100.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: This measures vocabulary polarity, not goodness or evil. Negation, sarcasm and fantasy meanings are not resolved. Inspect words and lines in the interactive version.
